scope: Theorem 11.1 of the manuscript “Exact orders and invariant anticanonical linear systems” (preprints/Exact-orders-and-invariant-anticanonical-linear-systems-September-26-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 068 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 f93f24f5a8ef95cf), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 27. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let X be smooth connected projective with q(X) = 0, and let A = −KX carry a smooth semipositive Hermitian metric. Let an algebraic torus T act on X, and use the natural linearization on A. Let G be a pseudoeffective T-linearized line bundle. Suppose that for an unbounded set I of positive integers there are nonzero sections δj ∈ H0 (X, jA − G)T (j ∈ I). Then H0(X, mA)T ̸= 0 for some integer m > 0.
